description: Tick (or untick) one checklist item in a note on sharenotes.dev, found by its text. Use it when the user asks you to mark an item done, for example after you finish a task from their list. Read the note first with read_note: items show as "[ ] text" or "[x] text". It changes only that item's tick; it never deletes or rewrites text. A note with a PIN needs the PIN the user gave you. Everyone viewing the note sees the change straight away.

done.description: true ticks the item (the default); false unticks it.

item.description: The text of the checklist item, as read_note shows it (without the [ ] or [x]).

note.description: The note link, e.g. https://sharenotes.dev/blue-fox-42, or just blue-fox-42.

pin.description: The note's PIN (4-6 digits), only if the user gave it to you for this note. Never guess one.

name: check_item
title: Tick a checklist item in a ShareNotes note
